messages.subject: [Referral from Kate Borden] UT Austin Student Interested in Banking @ Houlihan LA
messages.body:
Hello Danny,

I hope you are doing well. My name is Jonathan Nachman, and I'm a sophomore
Economics and Business Student at the University of Texas, Austin. I had
the opportunity to speak with Kate over the phone yesterday to learn more
about Houlihan's CFR group and the Summer (2025) Analyst Internship
Program. I am especially interested in your CFR group, particularly the
consumer entertainment aspect of it. I am eager to learn more about the
group and the upcoming recruiting process.

If you have any free time next week, I would love to set up a quick phone
call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to
accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be
willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan

--
*Jonathan Nachman *
University of Texas, Austin
Economics & Business
M: (310)-292-4712

messages.body:
Danny – I greatly appreciate you spending the time to hop on the phone with
me today. Your additional insight into the OOH Entertainment group was very
useful and further excites me to continue pursuing this position. I wanted
to let you know that I just submitted my online application for the "2025
Summer Financial Analyst (Class of 2026) - Corporate Finance, Los Angeles
Consumer, Food & Retail" position. Thanks again for your help!

Best,
Jonathan
